name: claude-ref
description: Claude 참고자료 — 탭 기반 레퍼런스 · 작업축 · 프롬프트 저장소

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('_site',{recursive:true,force:true})" && node tools/gate-all.mjs --pre && eleventy && node tools/gate-all.mjs --post
scripts.verify: npm run build && node tools/search-test.mjs --strict && node tools/gate-reverse-test.mjs && node tools/measure-print.mjs
scripts.pdf: node tools/build-pdf.mjs && node tools/pdf-expect.mjs && python tools/verify-pdf.py
